text: In Republican-era China, the Taoist priest Master Kau lives with his two clumsy students in a house guarded by talismans. Hired by the rich businessman Yam to [raise his father's coffin from the grave|trigger|unsealing what was shut away], Kau finds the body untouched by decay and knows [it has become a vampire|threat|the dead that rise]. The students forget to line the bottom of the coffin with enchanted ink, the corpse breaks out, and Kau fights back with [talismans and glutinous rice|images|holy and occult objects] while a [bitten student slowly starts to turn|rules|it passes to others].
